items.title: Anthropic Cowork Plugins Trigger $611B 'SaaSpocalypse' — Wall Street in Full Panic
items.summary: Anthropic's Claude Cowork launched 11 industry-specific plugins (legal, finance, HR, sales, data, marketing) that triggered a $611 billion selloff across SaaS and financial stocks. Goldman Sachs is already deploying Claude agents for trade accounting. CNN, Fortune, and Bloomberg all covered the rout as investors fear AI will obsolete entire software categories.
items.relevance: The platform you build on daily just shook Wall Street. Cowork plugins show the direction — specialized AI agents replacing expensive SaaS tools. The same agent architecture powers your Clawdbot setup

items.title: Claude Opus 4.6 Drops — Agent Teams, 1M Context, Parallel Multi-Agent Coding
items.summary: Anthropic released Opus 4.6 with 'agent teams' for parallel multi-agent development, 1M token context window, and deep financial analysis. Triggered a second wave of stock selloffs. Fortune notes it could 'make things worse' for enterprise software incumbents.
items.relevance: This is the model running your Clawdbot right now. Agent teams could parallelize AVA development — one agent on SwiftUI, another on ESP32, another on testing, all coordinated

items.title: OpenAI Fires Back with GPT-5.3-Codex & Standalone Mac App
items.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5.3-Codex within minutes of Opus 4.6 and a standalone Codex Mac app. Claims the model can 'build complex apps from scratch over days' and helped debug and deploy itself. CNBC reports it's part of a direct push to steal share from Anthropic and Cursor.
items.relevance: AI coding arms race = better tools for everyone. A standalone Mac coding app could be useful for quick AVA prototyping when you don't want full IDE setup

items.title: NVIDIA Vera Rubin Platform: Six New Chips for Trillion-Parameter Agentic AI
items.summary: NVIDIA detailed its Vera Rubin platform — six new chips (R100 GPUs, Vera CPUs, HBM4 memory) designed specifically for agentic AI at trillion-parameter scale. Unveiled at CES 2026, it's purpose-built for autonomous reasoning workloads. Jensen Huang says software stock selloff is overblown.
items.relevance: The hardware foundation for next-gen AI. Jensen pushing back on the SaaS panic is notable — he sees AI augmenting software, not replacing it entirely

items.title: Abbott Hit with FDA Warning Letter — Libre 3 Sensors Recalled Over Accuracy Issues
items.summary: FDA issued a warning letter to Abbott over accuracy problems with FreeStyle Libre CGMs. Certain Libre 3 and Libre 3 Plus sensors recalled due to incorrect glucose readings. CNET updated its CGM buying guide to flag affected lots. Major reliability concern for the most popular consumer CGM.
items.relevance: Libre is one of the most popular CGMs for kids. Reinforces why AVA's education on recognizing symptoms (not just trusting devices) matters. If Kaislyn uses Libre, check sensor lot numbers

items.title: FDA Expands MiniMed 780G — Now Cleared for Ultra-Rapid Insulins Fiasp & Lyumjev
items.summary: Medtronic received 510(k) clearance for MiniMed 780G with Novo Nordisk's Fiasp and Eli Lilly's Lyumjev ultra-rapid insulins. Also cleared for Abbott's Instinct CGM with Type 2 diabetes. Medicare beneficiaries now have full access.
items.relevance: Ultra-rapid insulins + auto-delivery = faster corrections. AVA's simulation could model Fiasp/Lyumjev insulin action curves to teach kids how different insulins behave differently

items.title: India AI Impact Summit 2026 — First Global AI Summit in the Global South (Feb 16-20)
items.summary: India hosts the first global AI summit in the Global South, Feb 16-20 in New Delhi. Speakers include Sundar Pichai, Jensen Huang, Bill Gates, and Sam Altman. Five-star hotel prices skyrocketing. Agenda covers AI governance, compute infrastructure, and emerging market deployment.
items.relevance: All the major AI leaders in one room next week. Watch for announcements — Pichai (Gemini updates), Jensen (Rubin details), and Altman (GPT-5 roadmap) could all drop news

items.title: Home Assistant 2026.2 — New Default Dashboard, Area-Based Automation, Device Database
items.summary: Major HA update: redesigned 'Overview' dashboard that auto-organizes by area, simplified add-ons as 'Apps', integration with Open Home Foundation's public device database, and improved climate/energy area assignments. Developer tools moved to Settings.
items.relevance: If you ever set up smart home automation for the workshop or home, HA 2026.2 makes area-based automations much easier. Could also integrate ESP32 devices from AVA projects
